blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Robinsons Land Corp. (RLC) has joined the government’s Expanded Pambansang Pabahay para sa Pilipino (Expanded 4PH) Program, making its residential projects available to qualified Pag-IBIG Fund members under preferential pricing and buyer incentives. Under the memorandum of understanding, qualified Pag-IBIG members can purchase participating RLC Residences units using Pag-IBIG housing loans, including some ready-for-occupancy homes. RLC is the latest addition to Pag-IBIG’s housing program partnerships, which include Ayala-led Avida Land Corp. and Amaia Land Corp., SM Development Corp., Filinvest Land Inc., and Megawide Dreamrise Residences Inc. “We know how much owning a home means to our members and their […]...
